# Farmhouse Artisan Cheese

> Independent artisan cheese shop at 345 Kerr Street in Kerr Village, Oakville, Ontario. Curated local and international cheeses, charcuterie boards, specialty grocery, and gift boxes.

## About

Farmhouse Artisan Cheese is a specialty cheese shop in Kerr Village, Oakville, Ontario. We carry a carefully curated selection of artisan and farmhouse cheeses from local Canadian producers and international cheesemakers. Our counter changes with the seasons and reflects what is at its best — whether that is a buttery Quebec triple cream in spring or an aged Alpine cheese in winter.

In addition to cheese, we carry fine charcuterie, specialty grocery items, preserves, crackers, and honeys. We build custom cheese and charcuterie boards for personal entertaining, events, and corporate occasions, and curate gift boxes for any budget.

We publish a monthly newsletter called The Farmhouse Gazette and maintain a blog (Tasting Notes) covering cheese education, seasonal recipes, and food culture.

**Address:** 345 Kerr Street, Oakville, ON L6K 3B7, Canada
**Phone:** +1-905-582-9600
**Email:** info@farmhouseartisancheese.com
**Hours:** Monday–Friday 10am–6pm · Saturday 10am–5pm · Sunday 11am–4pm

## Blog — Tasting Notes

- [Five Heat-Proof Cheeses for Confident Outdoor Hosting](https://farmhouseartisancheese.com/BlogPages/heat-proof-cheeses.html): Which cheeses hold up at summer temperatures and why.
- [The Art of the Cheese Cave](https://farmhouseartisancheese.com/BlogPages/cheese-caves.html): How aging environments shape flavour and texture.
- [Quebec's Quiet Revolution](https://farmhouseartisancheese.com/BlogPages/quebec-cheeses.html): How Quebec became North America's leading cheese region.
- [The Temperature Rule](https://farmhouseartisancheese.com/BlogPages/cheese-prep.html): Why room temperature matters and how to serve cheese properly.
- [Cheese 101: Rinds](https://farmhouseartisancheese.com/BlogPages/rinds.html): Washed rind vs. bloomy rind — what to eat and what to leave.
- [The Truth About Lactose & Cheese](https://farmhouseartisancheese.com/BlogPages/lactose.html): How aging affects lactose levels and what that means for sensitive eaters.
- [A Gift Worth Savouring](https://farmhouseartisancheese.com/BlogPages/blog-gift-worth-savouring.html): The case for giving cheese as a gift.
